publication_rule: Strictly earlier than public claim date, verified per retrieved page. Same-day, uncertain and later pages are logged and excluded from model evidence.
input_rule: Public caption, original images, time and location only. Search terms manually condensed from the caption. Source follow-up uses original-record, author, or image-credit clues. Reference QA, fact-check answers and labels are sealed off from retrieval and prediction.
source_confirmation: Textual evidence lineage requires a direct, attributable public record, or explicit common origin or reprint attribution. Exact visual asset attribution requires comparison with an actual source image. Distinct domains alone prove neither independence nor common source.
comparison: Before: initial admissible excerpts; after: same initial excerpts plus admissible follow-up excerpts and supported attribution notes. Any change is a paired descriptive outcome. Only confirmed-source cases separately assessed; additional evidence can affect the decision.
